notes:
A broad term for rooms available for hourly or short-term rental. In Japan, these are widely available in urban areas and serve many purposes: business meetings, study groups, hobby activities, small parties, photo shoots, and remote work. They can be found through online booking platforms and are often located in commercial buildings near train stations.
